name: The Wolf's Tailor
dinnerNote: Fall tasting menu, built around Colorado corn and wood-fired cooking

menus.name: Fall tasting menu
menus.note: No changes for dietary restrictions or dislikes, only severe allergies, and this menu can't avoid corn, sunflower, sesame, ginger, allium, nightshade, soy or mushroom

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable, or by phone. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 5pm to 8:30pm; closed Mondays. There's seating in the dining room, the garden or a private heated tent.
